input.summary:
C ground furnished in parts/room-9.mjs with layers(): a parlour at the front (four-chair spruce table under a hanging lantern, potted poppy by the bay), a stone-brick kitchen counter in front of the hearth at x=20 z18..19, and a back table with two chairs; the x=25 lane and the stair well x20..21 z20..23 are kept clear.
After make.sh: light min 8, 0 dark, 0 dim cells on C ground; mcd check shows 0 floating and 0 unsupported blocks from my part (its orphans are shell bay blocks). The room image reads as a parlour and kitchen.

waste.what: Lantern spots found by trial: three rebuilds moving lanterns to clear dim corners, because the room tool's first suggestion was a floor lantern on the stair-well cell (20,3,22) and I had to reason out the 3D distance from each lantern to the feet myself.
waste.cost: 3 make.sh rebuilds plus 2 room checks, about 2 minutes
waste.tool: mcd room should suggest hanging spots (y = ceiling-1) and exclude cells inside a stair well or other locked reserved cells; a light-by-distance preview per candidate would avoid rebuilds

waste.what: Working out the stair-well and hearth cells by hand from plan.md (x20..21 z20..23, firebox x20 z18..19), since the stairs and chimneys parts were stubs and the floor grid showed them as free floor.
waste.tool: plan --rooms should mark reserved and locked cells (stair well, firebox) distinctly from free floor, using the built neighbour parts' cells when they exist

waste.what: Chair facings and table layout worked out cell by cell: which way each stair faces so its back sits against the table's far side.
waste.tool: a furnish helper in the build library: table(g, x, z, chairs: [sides]) that writes fence, slab and facing-correct stairs in one call

companions.task: Confirm at merge that the flight in the x20..21 z20..23 well leaves the chair at (22,3,21) and the back table clear of its head and foot, and that the well cells I left empty match its footprint.
Confirm the C firebox at x=20 z18..19 faces east with its campfire at x=20, so my kitchen counter at x22 and the clear front cells at x21 z17..19 line up with the fire.
Build the cupboard and sideboard the parlour lacks. Palette.json has no barrel, bed, carpet, candle or chest, so the room has no beds or stores yet.
Check the light once the front door and bay are built: the room tool's walk and light readings change when the outside is real.

left: Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE until the front door (25,3..4,12) and the outside are built; re-run mcd room after the merge to confirm the x=25 lane is walkable front to back.
Stair well x20..21 z20..23 and hearth at x=20 z18..19 come from the stairs and chimneys parts; re-check clearance at merge.

Palette has no barrel, bed, carpet, candle or chest, so the room has no beds, storage or rugs; I used stairs, fence and slab furniture only. A palette addition or a second pass with the carpenter is needed for a full home.
No elements.md items are interior furniture, so there was nothing to tick in plan.md or elements.md.
